name: audio-equalizer
title: Audio Equalizer
description: Level bars that bounce while audio plays and settle into a calm wave when it stops or when motion is reduced.

props.name: playing
props.description: Bars bounce while true; under reduced motion they hold a resting shape.

props.name: size
props.description: Height of the tallest bar in px.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one bounce of the slowest bar.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes; the bars take the text color.
